summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose an updated corporate presentation and a press release regarding a clinical update at the ISCT 2026 Annual Meeting. The press release highlights positive results from ongoing Phase 1 trials of TPST-2003, a dual-targeting CAR-T therapy, for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma and POEMS syndrome. The filing contains no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes. It is a routine clinical update disclosure, not a special-situation event.
